cli.intro: OpenIDA — inspect binary headers, sections, strings, bytes and patches.

cmd.capabilities: Print what this build supports, honestly
cmd.info: Open a binary and print its format, architecture, entry point and hash
cmd.sections: Print the section table with addresses, file offsets and access flags
cmd.strings: Extract printable ASCII runs with their file offsets
cmd.hexdump: Print a canonical hex dump of one byte range
cmd.rva: Map an RVA or virtual address onto a file offset
cmd.patch: Write bytes atomically and report the before/after hashes

opt.limit: Maximum number of strings to return (default 100)
opt.offset: File offset to inspect, decimal or 0x-prefixed
opt.bytes: Hex bytes to write, such as 90,90 or 0x90 0x90
opt.out: Write the patched copy here instead of the source file
